cores.name: Double Down
cores.textbox: You may destroy a Gold you control rather than pay this card's {r} cost.{br}The next attack that **wagers** this turn gets +3{p} and **overpower**.{br}If a hero would create 1 or more tokens from a **wager** this turn, instead they create that many plus 1 of each of those tokens.{br}**Go again**

product.description:
The smell hits you first. Blood… Sweat… Steel…

Feral crowds roar loud as the thumping in your chest. You step into the arena, hot sand billowing at your feet. Drinks are poured, wagers are made, weapons are drawn…

Gold and glory is yours for the taking… If you survive the Deathmatch Arena!
